description: This file implements a menu box UI component for a dialog system, with functions to display menu options, handle user input, and manage scrolling and button interactions. It is part of a larger dialog library, likely used in text-based interfaces such as setup screens or configuration menus.
external_methods: drawer functions like draw_shadow, draw_box, print_title, print_autowrap, print_button, on_key_esc, on_key_resize
ncurses library functions such as newwin, wmove, waddch, waddstr, wrefresh, delwin, keypad, getmaxyx, getyx

methods.name: void do_print_item(WINDOW * win,const char * item,int line_y,int selected,int hotkey)
methods.description: Displays a single menu item on the window, highlighting if selected and showing a hotkey indicator.

methods.name: void print_arrows(WINDOW * win,int item_no,int scroll,int y,int x,int height)
methods.description: Displays scroll indicators (up and down arrows) based on current scroll position and total items.

methods.name: void print_buttons(WINDOW * win,int height,int width,int selected)
methods.description: Displays the control buttons at the bottom of the dialog.

methods.name: void do_scroll(WINDOW * win,int * scroll,int n)
methods.description: Scrolls the menu window up or down by a specified number of lines.

methods.name: int dialog_menu(const char * title,const char * prompt,const void * selected,int * s_scroll)
methods.description: Core function that creates and manages a scrollable menu dialog, handles user input, and returns selected options or command codes.
